title: Daq wordmark
description: A thin-line lucide cube beside a bold, widely tracked name with a tiny monospace sub-line under it. Optionally the name's letters rise in one after another on load.
notes: the letter rise is CSS (fill-mode both) and is off under reduced motion

props.name: name
